items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I was playing Monday Date and things by Louie Armstrong

ctx.x: And they conducted in all the pub -- Public Theaters -- Balaban and Katz Theaters in Chicago. So they used to hear me play on these records, and I was playing Monday Date and things by Louie Armstrong -- and they said that they had worked at a club on the South Side, and that they'd worked in the show. And that how Louie used to come out on the floor and just play to them and really sell them.
